verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Authenticator supports passkey sign-in with biometric/PIN phishing-resistant authentication (docs-23), alongside its traditional OTP/push-approval MFA flows (docs-12, docs-24). However, passkey storage/sync details, cross-device passkey management, and independent hands-on corroboration of passkey use are thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of passkey sign-in working smoothly, details on passkey backup/sync across devices, broader website compatibility examples beyond Microsoft's own docs.
